title: pyobfus.yaml
description: Configuration file for pyobfus, the Python code obfuscator. Generated from pyobfus/config_schema.py -- do not hand-edit; run scripts/generate_vscode_schema.py to regenerate.

exclude_patterns.description: File patterns to exclude (glob syntax). Extends the preset's baseline, doesn't replace it.

exclude_names.description: Names to never rename (builtins, imports, Pro infrastructure, ...). Extends the preset's baseline.

numeric_obfuscation.description: Opaque arithmetic identities for numeric literals (Community).

strip_ai_artifacts.description: Remove AI provenance markers ("Generated by Claude", etc.) from docstrings and attribution dunders (Community).

preserve_param_names.description: Keep function parameter names intact so keyword arguments survive obfuscation.

string_encryption.description: AES-256 string encryption (Pro). Requires level: pro.

import_obfuscation.description: Rewrite imports to runtime importlib calls + encrypted import strings (Pro). Requires level: pro.

anti_debug.description: Inject runtime debugger-detection checks: sys.gettrace, TracerPid, IsDebuggerPresent, timing skew (Pro). Requires level: pro.

control_flow_flattening.description: Flatten control flow into an opaque dispatch loop (Pro). Requires level: pro.

dead_code_injection.description: Inject plausible-looking dead code as decoy (Pro). Requires level: pro.

license_expire.description: License expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). Import raises after this date (Pro). Requires level: pro.

license_bind_machine.description: Bind the license to the current machine's hardware fingerprint (Pro). Requires level: pro.

license_max_runs.description: Maximum run count before the license refuses to run; 0 = unlimited (Pro). Requires level: pro.

selective_opacity.description: Enable per-symbol layered protection (opacity layers) for @opacity-decorated functions (Pro). Requires level: pro.

seal_code.description: Bytecode integrity seal for @seal_code-decorated functions -- detects in-memory patching (Pro). Requires level: pro.

vault.description: Encrypt vault_secrets({...}) runtime constants into an AES-256-GCM Vault (Pro). Requires level: pro.

scrub_traceback.description: Encrypt production tracebacks (RSA-2048-OAEP + AES-256-GCM hybrid); reverse with pyobfus-unscrub (Pro). Requires level: pro.

fingerprint.description: Per-buyer deterministic forensic watermark key (buyer id) (Pro). Requires level: pro.

expire_hard.description: Module-top hard expiration check (ISO date) baked into the build (Pro). Requires level: pro.

period_max_runs.description: Module-top run-counter limit baked into the build (Pro). Requires level: pro.

opacity_config.description: Path to an opacity.toml pattern-driven layer-assignment file (Pro). Requires level: pro.

bind_device.description: Derive Selective Opacity + Vault keys from the bound machine's fingerprint at runtime (Pro). Requires level: pro.

bind_device_id.description: Target machine-id for bind_device; omit to use the build machine's own fingerprint (Pro). Requires level: pro.

requires_os.description: Comma-separated allowed OS names (platform.system() values) -- import refuses to run elsewhere (Pro). Requires level: pro.

requires_python_min.description: Minimum required Python version, e.g. "3.10" (Pro). Requires level: pro.

requires_arch.description: Comma-separated allowed CPU architectures (platform.machine() values) (Pro). Requires level: pro.

embed_data.description: Path to a resource file to AES-256-GCM encrypt and embed as a module constant (Pro). Requires level: pro.

max_workers.description: Parallel worker count for multi-file builds; omit for the automatic cpu_count-based default.

max_files.description: Maximum files per build (Community tier limit; omit for unlimited).

max_total_loc.description: Maximum total lines of code per build (Community tier limit; omit for unlimited).

preset.description: Named preset to use as the base configuration; individual keys below override or extend it.
